voice.name: Benjamin - Deep and Calm
voice.why: A deep, calm middle-aged French voice for the station desk officer: firm without shouting. The game has male bodies only; the voice is male.

greet.text: Officer on duty. Keep your hands where I can see them, and we will get along.

what.text: I keep the peace and take the reports. Break into a shop or hurt someone and you will see me again.

where.text: The station is the building behind me. The town board on the square lists everything else.

rumour.text: We have had burglaries along the main street. If you saw anything, tell us. People here remember faces.
